title: Filler: A Bowl to Celebrate
later: Ramen! ...After you're done with your thing. Then we're celebrating, believe it!

offer.speaker: naruto
offer.text: Look, look! A real headband! Iruka-sensei's taking me to Ichiraku to celebrate!

offer.speaker: naruto
offer.text: You helped that night, so you're coming too. Come on!

steps.text: Celebrate at Ichiraku Ramen with Naruto and Iruka-sensei

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: Ow... careful with the back, Naruto. Mizuki's shuriken still remember me.

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: Eat, before it gets cold. Both of you. You earned it.

dialogue.speaker: naruto
dialogue.text: Someday, I'll be Hokage, and everybody in the village will know my name. Even the ones who glared at me.

choices.text: I'll be right there, Lord Seventh.

lines.speaker: naruto
lines.text: Lord Seventh... Heh. It sounds awesome!

choices.text: Only if you beat me first.

lines.speaker: naruto
lines.text: Ha! You're on! A rival, believe it!
